description: This Java class 'Utils' provides static utility methods for an Android application, including permission checks, distance formatting, shared preferences management, bitmap asset handling, node connectivity, and device inset calculations, used across mobile and wearable apps.

classes.name: Utils
classes.description: A utility class with static methods for permissions, distance calculations, preferences, bitmap handling, node connectivity, and device inset calculations for Android mobile and wearable apps.

methods.name: checkFineLocationPermission
methods.description: Checks if the app has ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION permission; always true on pre-Marshmallow devices.

methods.name: formatDistanceBetween
methods.description: Calculates and formats the distance between two LatLng points in meters or kilometers.

methods.name: storeLocation
methods.description: Stores latitude and longitude in shared preferences.

methods.name: getLocation
methods.description: Retrieves stored location from shared preferences if permission is granted.

methods.name: loadBitmapFromAsset
methods.description: Synchronously loads a Bitmap from a wearable Asset; should be called from a background thread.

methods.name: createAssetFromBitmap
methods.description: Creates a wearable Asset from a Bitmap.

methods.name: getNodes
methods.description: Returns a collection of connected wearable node IDs; should be called from a background thread.

methods.name: calculateBottomInsetsOnRoundDevice
methods.description: Calculates adjusted insets for round devices based on display size and system insets.
